description: This Perl module defines a class 'Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods' that provides shorthand methods for calling ResultSource or Schema methods, including date/time formatting/parsing and transaction management.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods
classes.description: A class providing shorthand methods for date/time formatting, parsing, and transaction control, acting as a proxy to underlying storage and source methods.

methods.name: format_date
methods.description: Formats a date using the result source storage's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_datetime
methods.description: Formats a datetime using the result source storage's datetime parser.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string using the result source storage's datetime parser.

methods.name: parse_datetime
methods.description: Parses a datetime string using the result source storage's datetime parser.

methods.name: txn_do
methods.description: Executes a code block within a transaction.

methods.name: format_bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 1 or 0, with a workaround for issue #142.
